author: Nerdstalgic
description:
How I Met Your Mother remains one of the most beloved sitcoms of all time, but it's also one of the most controversial. From character arcs that divided fans to a series finale that still sparks debate years later, How I Met Your Mother made a few major mistakes that changed how audiences remember the show.

Whether you're a longtime fan or revisiting the series for the first time, this compilation dives deep into the writing choices, character arcs, and controversial finale that continue to define How I Met Your Mother.
